Q5004.reason: The shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach 25 can vest too remotely under the common-law Rule Against Perpetuities, so it is void and the friend holds fee simple absolute.

Q8166.reason: Maine’s “hitherto” describes what had already happened in the societies he studied, but the line is commonly misread as a prediction of future legal change.

Q5649.reason: A catheter valve lets the bladder fill and empty at intervals, but immediately after surgery the bladder needs continuous drainage, so a valve is not used.
